Whether you're revamping your home, moving into a new space, or simply eyeing that dream sofa, this is the perfect chance to **save big on designer furniture** in Singapore.

For a limited time only, enjoy:
✅ **Up to 70% OFF** on selected designer furniture

✅ **FREE Delivery** on your purchases (Min spend $500)


From stylish **leather recliners** to cozy **modular sectionals** , our showroom is filled with deals that are perfect for anyone looking for a **high-quality furniture sale in Singapore** .

- Massive markdowns on showroom models
- Extra discounts on already reduced **clearance sofas**
- Limited-time promotion – available **only until 20 April (Sunday)**
- Stock is moving FAST – come early for the best selection!


Whether you're upgrading your living room, refreshing your guest space, or creating the ultimate Netflix corner, our **Tagore furniture sale** has something for every home.

**Promotion ends:** **20 April 2025 (Sunday)**

To make things even better, we’re throwing in **FREE delivery** on your furniture buys during this relocation sale! Whether you're purchasing a single piece or furnishing your entire home, we’ll make sure it gets to you safely and smoothly. *(Min spend $500)*

## Don’t Miss the Best Sofa Clearance Sale in Singapore!


This is your chance to bring home beautifully crafted furniture at a fraction of the price. HomesToLife is known for its comfort-driven designs and high-quality craftsmanship – and now, you can experience it for less.


🪑 From modern sectionals to timeless recliners, this **furniture sale in Singapore** is too good to pass up.


👉 Drop by our Tagore showroom before 20 April and enjoy incredible savings before we relocate.


**See you at HomesToLife @ Tagore – where comfort meets great deals! 😊**
